name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.41.0: fridge builds load straight into the OTA publish form. The snarl-fridge CI attaches every new version to a fridge-v<name> release on this repo; GET /api/v1/app-release/latest-build?app=fridge (ag_admin) finds the newest one and the App updates panel fills version code, name and APK url from it with one button, so nobody copies a number or a link by hand. It only fills: publishing and choosing machines stay manual. The panel also gains a card and a halt/resume button for the fridge release, which had neither, and the fleet table now compares each machine with its own app line instead of judging fridges against the coil build. Cumulative over v6.40.1.
